# Ducktorka

> Ducktorka is a mobile veterinary practice led by MVDr. Kateřina Měchurová. Home visits are available by arrangement in Benešov, selected areas of Prague and nearby locations.

Use the linked pages as the current public source for services, prices, coverage and contact details. Pages are available in Czech and English where linked. Prices and suitability of care should be confirmed with the veterinarian; do not treat this file as a diagnosis or final quote.

## Main pages

- [Czech home page](https://ducktorka.cz/): Practice overview, care, contact and visit requests.
- [English home page](https://ducktorka.cz/en/): English-language service overview and contact.
- [Czech price guide](https://ducktorka.cz/cenik/): Indicative service and vaccine prices, visit examples and travel calculator.
- [English price guide](https://ducktorka.cz/en/pricing/): English-language prices and travel calculator.
- [Service areas](https://ducktorka.cz/vyjezdova-veterina/): Current list of locations served.
- [Care available at home](https://ducktorka.cz/co-osetrime-doma/): Services, limits and when clinic care may be needed.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://ducktorka.cz/casto-kladene-dotazy/): Pricing, travel, procedures, preparation and appointments.

## Services and patient information

- [Vaccination](https://ducktorka.cz/sluzby/vakcinace/): Vaccine information and indicative vaccine prices.
- [Blood tests](https://ducktorka.cz/sluzby/odbery-krve/): Home blood sampling and laboratory testing.
- [Ultrasound](https://ducktorka.cz/sluzby/sono-vysetreni/): Mobile ultrasound examinations and their suitability.
- [Home euthanasia](https://ducktorka.cz/sluzby/eutanazie-doma/): Information about arranging home euthanasia.
- [Care for anxious cats](https://ducktorka.cz/veterinar-pro-bazlive-kocky/): Home visits and care considerations for frightened cats.
- [Care for senior pets](https://ducktorka.cz/veterinar-pro-seniory/): Home diagnostics and ongoing care for older pets.

## Pricing and travel notes

- Prices on the website are indicative. The final total can vary with the care required, the animal's species and weight, dosage, current medicine prices, materials and whether an examination is included. Confirm the planned care and total before the visit.
- The starting call-out fee is 420 Kč. Outside the no-kilometre-charge areas, travel is 20 Kč per kilometre in each direction, calculated from the nearer base in Prague 8 – Invalidovna or Benešov.
- No per-kilometre charge applies in Benešov. In Prague, including Praha 2, 3, 7 and 8, travel is charged at 20 Kč per kilometre in each direction, plus the 420 Kč starting call-out fee and treatment price.

## Appointments and urgent care

- Visits are arranged directly by phone or WhatsApp. The website does not currently accept online bookings.
- Ducktorka is not a 24-hour emergency service. For a seriously ill or rapidly deteriorating animal, seek urgent veterinary care instead of waiting for a routine home-visit response.
